shortDesc: Row of daily weather tiles (icon, high/low in °C, chance of rain); today is highlighted. Takes the days array from GetWeather or GetDestination.forecast, and shows the source note (e.g. last year's weather) when given.

props.name: days
props.description: Array of { date, summary, weatherCode, tempMaxC, tempMinC, precipitationChance?, precipitationMm? } (GetWeather days / GetDestination forecast).

props.name: note
props.description: Source note, e.g. "Beyond the forecast range: weather on the same dates last year".

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-[minmax(76px,1fr)] gap-2 p-4 overflow-x-auto
styling.notes: Sky tiles, today in harbour navy with white text; DM Mono temperatures.
